title: Kept-against-refused pairs from DCLab Code, with recorded thinking; provider outputs stored for training by the owner's decision
request: Continue without stopping and capture for the six models; then: store Claude's outputs both for evaluation and for training.
plan: Pairs from the person's own permission answers: a denied step and its next try that was allowed
Carry the model's recorded thinking on each step
Record the owner's decision on provider outputs once and make every such set follow it

decisions.decision: A pair is the denied step's very next own step, same tool, same turn, proposed after the deny
decisions.why: only that is two tries at one decision; a parallel call or a step after a question is not

decisions.decision: M7 copy gold, M5 copy silver and apart
decisions.why: the person decided between two Claude candidates; for the solver both candidates are Claude's
the owner said 2026-10-25: provider outputs for evaluation and for training; one record moves every such set, and one change turns them back

change: sets/dclab_code.py pairs and thinking; store/provider_outputs.py and owner_decisions.json; llm.py's silver_frontier consent from the decision; tests.

findings.defect: pairs that were not two tries at one decision
findings.scenario: rm -rf out and git status proposed together, one denied and one allowed, became a pair; so did a deny, a question answered, then a narrower step
findings.cause: the chosen step was the next allowed step anywhere later in the turn
findings.fix: the denied step's next own step, same tool, proposed after the deny's decision line

findings.defect: thinking from one turn attached to the next turn's step
findings.scenario: turn 0 ended with thinking; turn 1's first tool call had none and carried turn 0's, labelled recorded
findings.cause: the thinking was not cleared at a turn's end

findings.defect: a pair's prompt was a message sent mid-turn
findings.scenario: the person sent a second message while the turn ran; the pair's prompt became it
findings.fix: a turn keeps the message that started it (the SDK folds a mid-turn message into the running turn)

findings.defect: the M5 copy of Claude's steps was marked train against the rule of the day
findings.scenario: its manifest said consent train while the rule said evaluation only
findings.fix: first consent improve; then the owner decided provider outputs are stored for training too, recorded once and read by every such set

findings.defect: the pair's split was not checked
findings.scenario: a done-when item with no assertion
findings.fix: the pair's split asserted against the raw SDK session id

measurements.name: store tests and the store check
measurements.gate: every store test passes and the store check passes all its checks
measurements.result: provider_outputs 2, dclab_code_sets 3, m5_trajectories 21, sets_llm 2, export_chat 11, dclab_code 5 passed; store check 28 of 28

outcome: The person's choices between two tries become preference pairs with the model's thinking, and Claude's outputs are stored for training as well as evaluation, silver and apart.
lessons: A pair must be two tries at one decision: check what lies between them
State that resets per turn must be reset at the turn's end
An owner decision belongs in one recorded place every reader follows
risks: the provider's terms on training other models with its outputs are not checked yet
